text: 下面进入大作文 05 · 人与自然与生态保护：绿色低碳发展与资源可持续利用答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：绿水青山画卷描摹与人与自然和谐共生立意。
Barren hills transforming into luxuriant green forests; ecological preservation is a vital prerequisite for sustainable prosperity.
绿色生态黄金立意：vital prerequisites for the sustainable prosperity of human civilization.
Ecological preservation is a vital prerequisite for sustainable prosperity.
第二段：破坏生态反噬 vs 绿色发展红利对比，融入预防古谚。
Reckless exploitation of resources will disrupt ecological equilibrium; economic advancement should never be pursued at the expense of environment.
反向批判金句：Economic advancement should never be pursued at the exorbitant expense of a devastated environment.
Economic advancement should never be pursued at the exorbitant expense of a devastated environment.
第三段：法制严惩与公众垃圾分类两手抓，以天人合一倒装收尾。
Stringent legal frameworks must be enforced; only in harmony with nature can mankind secure a thriving and promising future.
人与自然和谐倒装结语：Only in harmony with nature can mankind secure a thriving future.
Only in harmony with nature can mankind secure a thriving and promising future.
